Independently tested all fourteen explicit encoded line triples, each with four different rational curve points, and their sets are pairwise disjoint, covering all 56. Hasse–Weil upper bound 25+1+2*3*5=56 verifies maximality and Bezout four-intersection cap gives lower bound 14. These are finite exhaustive field checks plus proved geometric inequalities, not a generalization to other fields.
